subject: Evidence index and gap-closure plan for cross-border DPIA request
messages:
From: Oliver Kline <oliver.kline@novamed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: privacy-team@novamed.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:15:00 +0000
Subject: Request: evidence index + DPIA sampling approach for cross-border transfers

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, NovaMed’s privacy & legal teams need an evidence index and a recommended sampling/runbook to satisfy our DPIA and Article 28/30 audit checklist for transfers to Redwood’s hosted environment. Specifically we need:

- A compact index of artifacts you can provide (logs, transfer records, subprocessor list, DPA appendix, SOC2 snapshot).
- A proposed sampling methodology for production data flows (what you sample, date ranges, sample size rationale).
- A short gap-closure runbook if we identify missing items during audit (owner, time-to-remediate).

Can you share a draft index and an example runbook by next Wednesday (Mar 9)? We’ll attach this to our DPIA and share with our DPO.

Also: any attachments you send should include filenames and brief descriptions; we will request copies via our evidence portal but want an initial list from you first.

Appreciate it,
Oliver
Oliver Kline
Head of Privacy, NovaMed
oliver.kline@novamed.com
+44 20 5555 1212
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Kline <oliver.kline@novamed.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: evidence index + DPIA sampling approach for cross-border transfers

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear list.

High level: we can produce an evidence index and an operational sampling/runbook. I’ll coordinate the artifact pull with Lauren (controls/evidence owner) and Marcus (ops for logs and extraction). Preliminary plan below — we can iterate once we see NovaMed’s portal requirements.

What we will deliver by Wed 2027-03-09 (ETA):
- evidence-index.csv (artifact name, description, owner, retention window, access method)
- dpia-gap-closure-runbook-v1.pdf (template with owners, remediation SLAs, triage steps)
- onboarding-subprocessor-matrix.xlsx (current subprocessor list, data categories, transfer mechanisms)

Sampling methodology (short):
- Scope: cross-border transfers originating from EU production projects tied to NovaMed account IDs (we’ll ask you to confirm the account IDs/paths).
- Period: rolling 90-day window by default unless you specify a narrower date range.
- Sample size: stratified random sample across 3 buckets (control events, transfer logs, retention records). Typical size: 30 events per bucket or 5% of events if volume >10k.
- Evidence types: audit logs (read/write), agent transfer logs, data flow mappings (Art. 30 extract), DPA and SCCs, subprocessor attestations.

A few asks for NovaMed before we run the extraction:
1) Confirm the account IDs or project names you want in-scope.
2) Do you want redaction of subject-matter identifiers in logs? (we can provide hashed IDs).
3) Any formal evidence portal link or required filename conventions?

I’m copying Lauren and Marcus to assign pulls and packaging.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Privacy & Gov. Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Request: evidence index + DPIA sampling approach for cross-border transfers

Thanks — assigning tasks.

Marcus: can you export the transfer ledger and the prefix cache logs for the NovaMed account(s) for the 90-day window (CSV export, include UTC timestamps, transfer target region column)? Put the raw export on the secure evidence S3 under /evidence/novamed/raw/ and name it transfer-ledger-novamed-YYYYMMDD.csv. Estimated extraction time: 2 business days after we have confirmed account IDs.

Marcus: also prepare a short explanation paragraph that maps the ledger columns back to our Art.30 register fields (we’ll include that as a short readme in the index).

Soojin: I’ll author the evidence-index.csv skeleton (columns: artifact_id, filename, description, owner, access, retention, sample_note). I’ll also draft dpia-gap-closure-runbook-v1.pdf with triage steps and two SLA tiers: critical (48h to acknowledge, 10 business days to remediate) and standard (5 business days ack, 30 business days remedi).

Attachments (drafts):
- [stub] evidence-index-template.csv (columns listed above)
- [stub] dpia-gap-closure-template.docx

We should plan one 30-minute sync with NovaMed once they confirm account IDs to walk the sampling choices.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop

lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
